style.why: RemkaPro is a local service business targeting everyday people. Modern Clean communicates professionalism and reliability without being cold or corporate. The client wants 'надійний, професійний' mood and references apple.com — clean aesthetic. SP-18 Corporate Premium rejected — too formal for a repair service. SP-07 Warm Organic rejected — too soft, doesn't convey technical competence.

tokens.button_primary: bg-accent text-white rounded-xl px-8 py-3 font-semibold
tokens.button_secondary: border-2 border-primary text-primary rounded-xl px-8 py-3
tokens.decorative: subtle gradient mesh, geometric shapes with low opacity

header.why: Service business — phone number must be always visible. Top bar shows phone + hours, main nav is sticky with logo + links + CTA button. Simple and functional.

footer.why: Simple service business with 4 pages — classic footer with about, nav, services, contacts columns. No newsletter needed (not a content business).

sections.why: Repair service needs to show both value proposition (text) and credibility (photo of real technician). Split layout provides both. H-04 Full-Bleed rejected — no high-quality background photo available. H-05 Bento rejected — too complex for a simple message.
sections.notes: Left: headline + subheadline + 2 CTA buttons + trust line. Right: photo placeholder of technician at work.

sections.why: 4 advantages of equal weight — 2x2 icon grid is clean and scannable. F-06 Stat-Centric rejected — these are qualitative benefits, not big numbers. F-03 Alternating rejected — too much vertical space for 4 short items.
sections.notes: 4 cards in 2x2 grid. Each: icon + title + short description. Subtle hover effect.

sections.why: 3 services of equal importance — uniform cards in a row. Each card links to services page. SV-02 Zigzag rejected — 3 items don't need alternating layout.
sections.notes: 3 cards: icon + name + short description + individual CTA.

sections.why: 4-step process — horizontal numbered timeline is intuitive and compact. W-02 Vertical Timeline rejected — takes too much space for 4 simple steps.
sections.notes: 4 steps in a horizontal line with numbers, connectors between steps.

sections.why: 3 reviews — carousel allows featuring each one prominently while saving space. T-03 Masonry rejected — looks cluttered with only 3 items.
sections.notes: Star rating + review text + name. Auto-scroll with pause on hover.

sections.why: Price ranges by service type — simple table is the clearest format. P-02 Tiered Cards rejected — these aren't plan tiers, just service categories.
sections.notes: Table: service name + price range. Note about free diagnostics below.

sections.why: 5 questions — classic accordion is the most usable FAQ pattern. Compact and scannable. Q-02 Two-Column rejected — not enough items to fill two columns.
sections.notes: Expandable items, first one open by default.

sections.why: Simple final push — centered headline + CTA button + trust badges. C-03 Split with Form rejected — form adds friction for a phone-based service.
sections.notes: Accent background, large headline, prominent CTA button, trust line underneath.

sections.why: Inner page — just needs title and short description. No hero image needed for a services list page.
sections.notes: Simple: headline + description on dark background.

sections.why: 3 services with long descriptions — zigzag gives each service a full-width section with image + detailed text. Differs from home-services card grid.
sections.notes: Alternating: text left / image right, then text right / image left. Each with its own CTA.

sections.why: Same CTA pattern as home — consistency across pages.
Inner page header — clean and simple.
Company story — text with team/workshop photo creates human connection. A-02 Timeline rejected — company history is too short for a timeline.
sections.notes: Text block + photo placeholder on the right.

sections.why: 4 key numbers — horizontal counter row with animated counting on scroll. Clean and impactful.
sections.notes: 4 numbers in a row: repairs count, rating, response time, years.
Same pattern as other pages for consistency.

sections.why: Contact page — minimal header, content below.
Multiple contact methods — cards for phone, email, address, hours. Each card is a clear action point.
sections.notes: 4 cards: phone (clickable), email (clickable), address (with map link), working hours.

sections.why: Contact form with contextual info — left side has form, right side shows what happens after submission (call within 30 min, etc.).
sections.notes: Form: name, phone, description. Right: process after submission.
